Hi Liam,

Thanks for agreeing to be added to our supplier roster. To get you live for POs and payments we need a few standard items from your side: legal entity name, registered address, tax form (W-9 / W-8), AP contact for PO routing, and bank details for ACH. I've attached our onboarding spreadsheet to capture the fields we need.

Could you:
- Fill the attached Stratavox_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (tab "Legal & Remit")
- Attach a copy of your W-9 and a remittance-ready bank instruction (account + routing or SWIFT details)
- Confirm the name/email for purchase order receipt and invoice submission

If you'd rather drop the docs into the Drive folder linked below and grant access to ap@redwood.com, that works too.

I'll loop in AP if anything looks off once we receive the files. Goal is to have you set up as a payee and able to receive our first PO by next Tuesday (30 Sep).

Thanks,

Hi Liam — quick follow up after internal review:

Thanks for the W-9 and bank spreadsheet. Two small requests so we can finish ACH setup this week:
1) Could you provide a bank letter or a copy of a recent bank statement that shows the account and company name? This is a standard control for ACH. A PDF screenshot will do — please redact balances if needed.
2) For the PO mapping: we will send POs to payments@stratavox.io. Invoices should be sent to ap@stratavox.io; please confirm the exact invoice subject line you prefer so our AP matches them automatically (e.g., "Invoice — Redwood Inference — PO#").

Also attaching our current Redwood vendor MSA (Redwood_Vendor_MSA_v1.2.pdf). We ask vendors to sign the payment authorization page so our payments team can store a signed authorization in the vendor record. I created a short DocuSign envelope for the payment authorization to speed the process: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123def456

If you can return the bank proof and sign the payment authorization today, we can get you a test PO and confirm the vendor number.

Best,
Rafael
